module: Flowgraph node "Rally Mode Race Editor Path" (category once_instant, tag rally). Returns the race file name to use in the fname pin: 'race.race.json' (source "Mission") if a Mission Manager mission identifier is detected, otherwise the file opened in editor_raceEditor (source "Editor") if it is not a blank file (/gameplay/races/new.path.json or NewRace.race.json). In the editor, displays the source and the file.
notes: If editor_raceEditor exists but the opened file is blank, loadCurrentRaceFileState returns nothing (nil); fname is then nil.

drawCustomProperties.desc: Displays the race file and its source in the properties panel.

workOnce.desc: Determines the race file, logs it (level D) and writes it to the fname pin.
